newsitem.title: USA: Ascend shares plunge on weak July results.
newsitem.headline: Ascend shares plunge on weak July results.

text.p: Ascend Communications Inc. stock plunged 9.6 percent Monday after the computer networking equipment maker revealed it had weaker-than-expected earnings in July.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the Alameda, Calif., company said it earned $2.9 million on sales of $62.8 million for the 31-day period ended July 31.
That would mean Ascend's sales are far behind the $330 million Wall Street expects the company to report for the quarter ending September, analysts said.
"To make that kind of forecast, Ascend would have to make a heroic effort," said Martin Pyykkonen, analyst at investment bank Furman Selz.
Ascend stock fell $4.75 to $44.6875 on Nasdaq trading of 24.8 million shares, making the stock the most active in U.S. markets.

It is too early to tell why July results were less than expected, analysts said. One reason could be some customer wins by Cisco Systems Inc., Ascend's primary rival and the biggest maker of networking equipment, Pyykkonen said.
Ascend officials could not be reached immediately for comment.
